#| label: setup

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(maps)

# Funktion definieren
read_hh <- function(zip_file) {

  keep <- c(
    "TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F", "USTAR", 
    "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
    "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF"
  )

  site <- strsplit(basename(zip_file), "_")[[1]][2]

  hh_name <- grep(
    "FLUXMET_HH",
    unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name,
    value = TRUE)

  unzip(
    zip_file,
    files = hh_name,
    exdir = "data/raw/unzipped",
    overwrite = TRUE)

  hh <- read_csv(
    file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
    na = "-9999",
    col_select = any_of(keep),
    col_types = cols(
      TIMESTAMP_START = "c",
      TIMESTAMP_END = "c",
      .default = "d"))

  # Add missing columns
  missing_cols <- setdiff(keep, names(hh))

  for (col in missing_cols) {
    hh[[col]] <- NA}

  # Put columns back in the desired order
  hh <- hh[, keep]

  hh <- hh |>
  rename(
    NEE  = NEE_VUT_REF,
    GPP  = GPP_NT_VUT_REF,
    RECO = RECO_NT_VUT_REF)

  hh <- hh |>
  mutate(
    site = site,
    time = as.POSIXct(
      TIMESTAMP_START,
      format = "%Y%m%d%H%M",
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  )
  return(hh)}

# alle Tower-Dateien finden
zip_files <- list.files("data/raw", pattern = "\\.zip$", full.names = TRUE)

countries <- c(US = "USA", CN = "China", FI = "Finnland", CD = "Kongo", AU = "Australien")

# alle Tower einlesen
all_hh <- do.call(rbind,lapply(zip_files, read_hh))

# Snapshot mit den Metadaten laden
snapshot <- read_csv("data/fluxnet_shuttle_snapshot_20261117T172817.csv",show_col_types = FALSE)

my_sites <- sort(unique(all_hh$site))

sites <- snapshot |>
  filter(site_id %in% my_sites) |>
  distinct(site_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(country = countries[substr(site_id, 1, 2)])

sites |>
  select(`Site ID` = site_id, Name = site_name, Country = country, IGBP = igbp,
         `Lat (°)` = location_lat, `Lon (°)` = location_long,
         `First year` = first_year, `Last year` = last_year,
         Hub = data_hub, Citation = product_citation) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

# Data Summary Report
## Site Overview

```{r}
#libraries
library (ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(here)

# map 
world <- map_data("world")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(long, lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey90", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_point(data = sites, aes(location_long, location_lat),
             colour = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = sites, aes(location_long, location_lat, label = site_id),
            nudge_y = 7, size = 3.5) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(x = "Longitude (°)", y = "Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Data Coverage

```{r}
coverage <- all_hh |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(time, "%Y"))) |>
  summarise(
    measured = mean(NEE_VUT_REF_QC == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(site, year))

ggplot(coverage, aes(year, site, fill = measured)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Measured NEE", labels = scales::percent,
                       limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Site") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

vars <- c(TA_F     = "TA_F (°C)",
          SW_IN_F  = "SW_IN_F (W m⁻²)",
          VPD_F    = "VPD_F (hPa)",
          P_F      = "P_F (mm)",
          NEE      = "NEE (µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹)",
          GPP      = "GPP (µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹)",
          RECO     = "RECO (µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹)",
          H_F_MDS  = "H (W m⁻²)",
          LE_F_MDS = "LE (W m⁻²)")

# Statistiken für alle Variablen und Türme
stats <- all_hh |>
  select(site, all_of(names(vars))) |>
  pivot_longer(-site, names_to = "var") |>
  summarise(Mean        = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            Min         = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            Max         = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            `% missing` = 100 * mean(is.na(value)),
            .by = c(site, var))

# Niederschlag: mittlere Jahressumme statt Mittelwert
p_annual <- all_hh |>
  mutate(year = format(time, "%Y")) |>
  summarise(p_sum = sum(P_F, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(site, year)) |>
  summarise(p_annual = mean(p_sum), .by = site)

stats <- stats |>
  left_join(p_annual, by = "site") |>
  mutate(Mean = if_else(var == "P_F", p_annual, Mean)) |>
  select(-p_annual)

# Eine Tabelle pro Turm
for (s in my_sites) {
  cat("\n\n### ", s, "\n\n", sep = "")
  tab <- stats |>
    filter(site == s) |>
    select(-site) |>
    mutate(var = vars[var]) |>
    pivot_longer(c(Mean, Min, Max, `% missing`), names_to = "Statistic") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = var, values_from = value)
  cat(knitr::kable(tab, digits = 1), sep = "\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Mean annual precipitation sum

precip_summary <- all_hh |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(format(time, "%Y"))
  ) |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_precip_mm = sum(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    `P_F Mean annual sum (mm)` = mean(annual_precip_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    `P_F Min annual sum (mm)`  = min(annual_precip_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    `P_F Max annual sum (mm)`  = max(annual_precip_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    `P_F Missing (%)` = 100 * mean(is.na(all_hh$P_F[all_hh$site == first(site)]))
  )

precip_summary
```

## Time Series

Half-hourly carbon fluxes were aggregated to daily means for each site and converted from µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹ to g C m⁻² d⁻¹ using a conversion factor of 1.0378.

### Daily aggregation

```{r}
daily <- all_hh |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time)) |>
  summarise(across(c(NEE, GPP, RECO), ~ mean(.x) * 1.0378),
            .by = c(site, date))
```

```{r}
daily |>
  pivot_longer(c(NEE, GPP, RECO), names_to = "flux") |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = flux)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(GPP = "darkgreen", RECO = "darkorange", NEE = "black")) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Daily flux (g C m⁻² d⁻¹)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```


### Validation against FLUXMET_DD

To verify the aggregation procedure, daily values derived from the half-hourly records were compared with the corresponding daily product for one site (CN-Du2).

```{r}
z       <- list.files("data/raw", pattern = "CN-Du2.*\\.zip$", full.names = TRUE)
dd_name <- grep("FLUXMET_DD", unzip(z, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)

dd <- read_csv(unz(z, dd_name), na = "-9999",
               col_select = c(TIMESTAMP, NEE_VUT_REF),
               col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP = "c", .default = "d")) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(TIMESTAMP, format = "%Y%m%d"))

cmp <- daily |>
  filter(site == "CN-Du2") |>
  inner_join(dd, by = "date")

ggplot(cmp, aes(NEE_VUT_REF, NEE)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  labs(x = "NEE from FLUXMET_DD (g C m⁻² d⁻¹)",
       y = "Own daily NEE (g C m⁻² d⁻¹)") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Diurnal cycles

```{r}
season_nh <- c("Winter", "Winter", "Spring", "Spring", "Spring", "Summer",
               "Summer", "Summer", "Autumn", "Autumn", "Autumn", "Winter")

diurnal <- all_hh |>
  left_join(sites |> select(site = site_id, lat = location_lat), by = "site") |>
  mutate(month  = as.integer(format(time, "%m")),
         # Südhalbkugel: Monate um 6 verschieben (Januar -> Juli usw.)
         month_adj = if_else(lat < 0, (month + 5) %% 12 + 1, month),
         season = factor(season_nh[month_adj],
                         levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")),
         hour   = as.numeric(format(time, "%H")) + as.numeric(format(time, "%M")) / 60) |>
  summarise(`NEE (µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹)` = mean(NEE, na.rm = TRUE),
            `LE (W m⁻²)`             = mean(LE_F_MDS, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = c(site, season, hour))

diurnal |>
  pivot_longer(-c(site, season, hour), names_to = "variable") |>
  ggplot(aes(hour, value, colour = site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ season, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 6)) +
  labs(x = "Hour of day (local standard time)", y = NULL, colour = "Site") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", legend.position = "top")
```

## My Reading

```{r}
eb <- all_hh |>
  filter(site == "CN-Du2", H_F_MDS_QC == 0, LE_F_MDS_QC == 0) |>
  mutate(available = NETRAD - G_F_MDS,
         turbulent = H_F_MDS + LE_F_MDS) |>
  filter(!is.na(available), !is.na(turbulent))

fit   <- lm(turbulent ~ available, data = eb)
slope <- coef(fit)[["available"]]

ggplot(eb, aes(available, turbulent)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0("slope = ", round(slope, 2), " (n = ", nrow(eb), ")")) +
  labs(x = "NETRAD − G (W m⁻²)", y = "H + LE (W m⁻²)") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
